mapper.select: SELECT LeaveID as leaveId, EmpID as empId, StoreID as storeId, LeaveType as leaveType, StartTime as startTime, EndTime as endTime, ApplyTime as applyTime, ApproverID as approverId, ApproveStatus as approveStatus, ApproveTime as approveTime, LeaveReason as leaveReason FROM leaveRecord WHERE EmpID = #{empId} AND (ApproveStatus = 'approved' OR ApproveStatus = '1') AND ( (StartTime <= #{startTime} AND EndTime >= #{startTime}) OR (StartTime <= #{endTime} AND EndTime >= #{endTime}) OR (StartTime >= #{startTime} AND EndTime <= #{endTime}) )

SELECT lr.LeaveID as leaveId, lr.EmpID as empId, e.EmpName as empName, e.EmpPhone as empPhone, e.Position as position, lr.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, lr.LeaveType as leaveType, lr.StartTime as startTime, lr.EndTime as endTime, lr.ApplyTime as applyTime, lr.ApproverID as approverId, approver.EmpName as approverName, lr.ApproveStatus as approveStatus, lr.ApproveTime as approveTime, lr.LeaveReason as leaveReason FROM leaveRecord lr LEFT JOIN employee e ON lr.EmpID = e.EmpID LEFT JOIN store s ON lr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN employee approver ON lr.ApproverID = approver.EmpID WHERE lr.LeaveID = #{leaveId}
